firstPlayerRule: Shuffle the restaurant chains’ turn-order markers and draw them to form the initial order. Starting restaurants are placed in reverse order, beginning with the last player.
clarifications: During play, Restructuring is simultaneous. In Order of Business, players choose positions on the turn-order track; most open company slots chooses first, with ties resolved by the previous turn order.
The first restaurant-placement pass permits passing. Those who passed must place in a second pass, in turn order.
